verdict.rationale: Warp's site says tax registrations, filings, and payments are handled automatically across all 50 states, and that Warp Agent takes on payroll and tax notices. That covers the core of automated payroll tax filing and remittance, though the support comes only from marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of federal and local (city/county) tax handling, documentation of the tax calculation itself, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
